units: <cite ref="Pesachim 56a:8">Pes. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>להביא בח׳</he> to offer it to her in secret.
<cite ref="Pesachim 56a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>שיהו אומרים … בח׳</he> that they say it in a whisper.

<cite ref="Arakhin 16a:69">Arakh. 16ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 88b:11">Zeb. 88ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 44a:5">Yoma 44ᵃ</cite> <he>דבר שבח׳</he> something done in secrecy (the offering of frank-incense on the inner altar); <he>מעשה שבח׳</he> what is committed in secrecy (calumny).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 5:6">Shek. V, 6</cite> <he>לשכת ח׳</he> the Hall of Secret (donations).
